text: China Eastern Airlines' controlling shareholder is state-owned China Eastern Air Holding, which held 55.80% of the airline after a May 2026 increase, and whose controlling shareholder with 68.42% is the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council (SASAC); the company's own filing names the State Council SASAC as the airline's actual controller.
short: China's State Council SASAC is China Eastern Airlines' actual controller, through China Eastern Air Holding (55.80%; SASAC 68.42%).

source.name: China Eastern Airlines Co., Ltd. — HKEX overseas regulatory announcement: legal opinion by Commerce & Finance Law Offices on the controlling shareholder's share increase
source.quote: 中国东航集团为公司的控股股东，国务院国资委为公司的实际控制人
source.note: Translation: 'China Eastern Air Holding is the company's controlling shareholder; the State Council SASAC is the company's actual controller.' The filing states the group held 54.76% before the increase and 55.80% after (as at 21 May 2026), directly and via wholly owned subsidiaries CEA Jin Kong and CEA International Holding (Hong Kong).

additionalSources.name: Dagong Global Credit Rating (via Sina Finance): 中国东航 2026年度信用评级报告 (China Eastern 2026 credit rating report)
additionalSources.quote: 东航集团为公司控股股东，共计持有公司总股本的54.76%（直接持有40.11%，间接持有14.65%），东航集团控股股东为国务院国有资产监督管理委员会
additionalSources.note: Continues: '（以下简称“国务院国资委”），持股68.42%，因此公司实际控制人为国务院国资委' — SASAC holds 68.42% of China Eastern Air Holding, so SASAC is the company's actual controller. Also lists China Eastern Air Holding's minority shareholders (国寿投资 11.21%, 上海久事 10.19%, 中国旅游集团 5.09%, 中国国新 5.09%).
